ui.tagline: Om · deep breathing · Anulom Vilom · silent meditation · Om
ui.readySub: Find a quiet seat, sit tall, and keep your phone close enough to hear.
ui.pausedSub: Breathe naturally. Tap Resume when ready.
ui.sleptSub: Paused because the screen went to sleep. Tap Resume.
ui.hint: Tap a section to jump to it. Space bar pauses and resumes.
ui.noVoice: This device has no English voice. Follow the words on screen and the chimes.

arrive.name: Arrive
arrive.desc: Settle the body and the breath

arrive1.say: Welcome. Sit comfortably, with the spine tall and the shoulders soft.

arrive2.say: Rest your hands on your knees. Gently close your eyes.

arrive3.say: Let the breath move naturally for a few moments.
arrive3.sub: Nothing to do yet. Just arrive.

omIntro.say: We begin with Om, three times. Breathe in, then chant along with the sound.

omChant.sub: Chant with the tone, let it vibrate in the chest

deep2.say: I will say the round number. Breathe in deeply through the nose, filling the belly, then the chest.

deep3.say: Then breathe out slowly and steadily for {e} seconds, until you feel empty.

deep4.say: Keep it smooth, with no strain. Let us begin.

roundOutLong.sub: Long, steady, all the way out

roundOut.sub: Long, steady, all the way out

deepRest.say: Let the breath return to normal. Notice how you feel.

av1.say: Next, Anulom Vilom. Alternate nostril breathing.

av2.say: Raise your right hand. The thumb closes the right nostril, the ring finger closes the left.

av3.say: Inhale through the left, exhale through the right. Then inhale right, exhale left. That is one round.

av4.cue: Close the right nostril with your thumb

avRest.say: Release the hand and rest it on your knee. Breathe naturally.

med2.say: Keep the eyes closed. Watch the breath, or silently repeat Om with each out-breath.

med3.say: When the mind wanders, gently come back. A bell will mark the halfway point and the end.

medA.sub: Watch the breath. Return gently when the mind wanders.

close2.say: We close with Om, three times.

palms.say: Rub your palms together, place them over your eyes, and slowly open your eyes.

end.say: Thank you. Carry this calm with you.
